sections.title: Overview
sections.body: This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect information when you visit or use SemrushGroupBuy. We aim to be transparent and keep this page in plain language.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We may collect information you provide directly (for example, email or account details when you sign up or contact support), and technical data such as IP address, browser type, and pages viewed, to run and secure the service.

sections.title: Cookies & similar tech
sections.body: We may use cookies or local storage for essential site functionality, preferences, and analytics. You can control cookies through your browser settings where supported.

sections.title: How we use data
sections.body: We use collected information to operate the site, process requests, improve performance, prevent abuse, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related questions, contact us through the support channels listed on this site. We may update this policy from time to time; the "Last updated" date above will change when we do.
